sentences.text:
Author: Suvra Ghosh Bench: Suvra Ghosh 15.07.2024 jb.
jdt CRR 2483 of 2024

In Re : Dr. Arnab Chakraborty & Ors.
 ... Petitioners  Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee  Sharequl Haque  Mr. Suman Majumder  ....

For the Petitioners The petitioners who are the husband and members of the matrimonial family of the private opposite party are aggrieved by the order passed by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 17 th Court,
Calcutta in G.R. no. 1038 of 2020 on February 19, 2024 turning down the prayer for discharge of the petitioners from the case.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the learned trial Court has misread the authorities on which he has placed reliance in the order impugned and has refused to discharge the petitioners from the allegations despite the fact that there is no prima facie material against them under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the heading 'Contested Application' on 27th September, 2024.

The order impugned passed by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 17th Court, Calcutta in G.R. no.
1038 of 2020 on February 19, 2024 be stayed till 30 th September, 2024 or until further orders,
whichever is earlier.

Urgent certified website copy of the order, if applied for, be given to the parties on compliance of requisite formalities.
CRR/2483/2024 on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21838322/
1 (Suvra Ghosh, J.)
